title: .NET 10 Demystified
speakerBio: .NET expert and full stack web developer with a deep passion for ASP.NET and building modern, interactive web applications. With years of experience in web development and .NET, he helps developers simplify their web apps while keeping them fast, maintainable. As a conference organizer and speaker, Kevin loves sharing practical insights on web development and fostering learning communities. When he’s not coding or speaking, he’s busy running Techorama and other developer events.
excerpt: A deep dive into .NET 10 features, performance tuning, and cloud-ready architecture.

title: Transitioning to IPv6
excerpt: IPv4 exhaustion is no longer theoretical. This session covered dual-stack deployments, migration strategy, and the security implications of IPv6.
speakerBio: Experienced network admin and Linux sysadmin, lecturer in the Bachelor Applied Informatics and the Bachelor CyberSecurity at Howest University of Applied Sciences in Bruges, a researcher in the Cluster IT, a Cisco Networking Instructor in Networking, Network Security and Cybersecurity Operations and a Cisco Instructor Trainer. He is also an advisor for BiASC, the Belgian IT Academy Support Center.He lives near Bruges, and he will interlace his presentation with some juicy anecdotes about the city, its beers and its history.

title: NATO Cyber Defence
excerpt: How NATO rethought defence for the digital domain, and why cybersecurity is now a shared responsibility across borders, sectors, and communities.
speakerBio: Expert on NATO cyber strategy and multinational cyber defence frameworks. He has graduated at the Polytechnic division of the Royal Military Academy in 1989 and started his career in F16 avionics. Later on, he switched to the world of software, hardware and networks and was ultimately given the responsibility to co-create cyberspace in the NATO context. After his military career, he started working for the NATO Headquarters, still in the area of IT and Cyber. This is where he is working today.
